pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/CodebaseArcheologistView/index.tsx:190 The archeologist report prints 'No anti-patterns detected' whenever every category count is zero and never checks analysis.totalFiles, so a scan that walked zero files (an empty Source/ tree, or a readdir error that collectSourceFiles swallows into []) shows as a clean result instead of 'could not run'.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/CodebaseArcheologistView/index.tsx:190 The clean verdict depends only on zero findings. Nothing checks that files were walked, so zero files scanned renders the same as zero defects. AntiPatternsTab.tsx:60 repeats this with 'No anti-patterns detected.' when totalCount === 0.

src/components/modules/evaluator/GDDComplianceView/ModuleCard.tsx:40 A module with no evidence shows UNMEASURED instead of a neutral score, and the header counts unmeasured modules (index.tsx:78), so missing evidence is announced rather than read as compliance.
